bug_semantics: Stored cross-site scripting in the anonymous public Atom/RSS feed: an administrator-controlled echo body is passed to gomarkdown with raw HTML enabled because html.SkipHTML is absent, then assigned to feeds.Item.Description and serialized by feeds.ToAtom as an HTML-type Atom summary. A reader that decodes and renders that summary executes injected script in the reader origin. A later, independent surface also interpolates persisted administrator-controlled tag.Name directly into #%s without HTML escaping, allowing a tag to break out of the span and inject script.
flaw_origin: Commit d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7 is the smallest BIC: one ordinary single-parent commit created the public GET /rss route, GenerateRSS, and the MdToHTML renderer, and connected untrusted stored echo content to the Atom description while omitting html.SkipHTML. Commit cc147955fd05c7b88b70268b8f11dfcde7c01d72 later added the unescaped tag interpolation, but it is not the earliest BIC because the raw-HTML RSS exploit path already existed from d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7.

evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/security/advisories/GHSA-3v85-fqvh-7rxf identifies the two sinks, the public /rss attack path, affected <=4.5.6, and patched 4.7.3; the assigned alias is https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9277-65xq-8gww. Source-history searches (`git log --all --reverse -S'MdToHTML([]byte(msg.Content))' -- internal/service/common/common.go` and `git log --all --reverse -S'html.CommonFlags' -- internal/util/md/md.go`) converge on BIC https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7. In that tree, internal/router/resource.go:8-11 publicly registers GET rss; internal/service/common/common.go:229-290 fetches stored echoes, passes msg.Content to MdToHTML at line 258, places the result in Item.Description at line 276, and calls feed.ToAtom at line 285; internal/util/md/md.go:10-22 creates the renderer with html.CommonFlags | html.HrefTargetBlank at line 17 and no html.SkipHTML. Direct-parent verification against 0c5d8226588c322f19668634624dcfc6efbe7c17 showed internal/service/common/common.go has no GenerateRSS or MdToHTML, while `git ls-tree -r --name-only 0c5d8226588c322f19668634624dcfc6efbe7c17 -- internal/util/md/md.go` and the same command for internal/router/resource.go both returned no path. The BIC diff creates both files, so the vulnerable route, renderer, and flow are absent from the immediate parent. `git log -L` traces the later tag-name line to cc147955fd05c7b88b70268b8f11dfcde7c01d72 at internal/service/common/common.go, with later commits only reformatting/refactoring it. Direct fix https://github.com/lin-snow/Ech0/commit/fd320fe3e9021c8d8d284fb274775c018690520e changes internal/service/common/common.go to apply html.EscapeString(tag.Name), changes internal/util/md/md.go to add html.SkipHTML, and adds tag-name metacharacter rejection in internal/service/echo/echo.go. Version checks found v4.5.6 (peeled commit 60e39455f8720bb50797f4fd2052e8e6c12db448) vulnerable, and merge-base returned the BIC itself, proving the BIC precedes that affected boundary. The v4.7.2 tree (peeled commit 88a564fcdd1ca0fbeecd75ed5f522df95372d308) still has the raw tag interpolation and MdToHTML without SkipHTML, so source history shows that 4.6.0 through 4.7.2 are also vulnerable despite the first-party advisory UI's narrower affected label. `git diff v4.7.2 v4.7.3` is the security change above; `git tag --contains fd320fe3e9021c8d8d284fb274775c018690520e --sort=version:refname` starts at v4.7.3/ech0-4.7.3, and merge-base of the fix with v4.7.3^{commit} returned the fix, proving first patched tag v4.7.3 (peeled commit 6ad621d8d461c58f1a1d179c4dfbb741803f8aa5). Finally, `git cat-file commit d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7` produced the exact human author/committer identities and marker-free one-line message recorded in ai_marker. The vulnerability lifecycle begins at d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7, not at a later move, refactor, release, or the tag feature. That commit simultaneously exposed /rss and introduced a permissive Markdown-to-HTML implementation, so stored raw HTML had a complete route from administrator input to an anonymously retrievable Atom HTML summary. Its immediate parent lacks the service method and both newly created route/renderer files, directly proving absence. cc147955fd05c7b88b70268b8f11dfcde7c01d72 expanded the already-vulnerable feed with a second unescaped tag sink; it does not displace the earlier, smaller causal BIC. fd320fe3e9021c8d8d284fb274775c018690520e closes both independently exploitable surfaces, and tag-tree inspection establishes v4.7.2 as vulnerable and v4.7.3 as the first release containing the fix. The BIC is a normal one-parent commit whose relevant feature is introduced directly, so no squash/member decomposition is warranted. AI attribution is judged only from the d1645e081c5a185e60e9a1ac68dedbced8c535f7 commit object; its human author/committer and marker-free message support NOT_AI regardless of any signals on later commits.
